author: trith72
quote:
Absolute disaster ****.  No heart, no soul, none of the mindless violent fun of the series.  This is a dating simulator, and VERY poor one, where you play as an emasculated loser chasing a mean, low IQ female around as her lapdog doing quests to raise her love score so she can just yell at you more and blame you for all her stupid life decisions.  Every female in the game talks to you like you are a dog and the game won't let you do anything but carry their purse for them and act like your family jewels were cut off months ago.  This is a pathetic excuse for a GTA title.  Do not buy this, wait until it comes out on PC and modders fix the game by allowing you to leave Lu in prison where she belongs, and removes all the no kill flags protecting the devs "special interest" groups....IYKYK.  This game should be about Jason only, Lu is feminist "It's a man's fault" cancer.  If I was a woman, I would be ashamed this game was ever made with the current female characters and socially constructed lies about masculinity.  There was a LOT of blue hair and nails in faces of the devs who made this slop.

Save your money, your sanity, and your manhood, hard freakin pass, this game looks great, but plays like a castration simulator.....
